summary: Regression + scheduler + UI-polish verification. RESULT: 20/20 backend pytest cases pass; scheduler + all 6 frontend pages verified end-to-end with real Apify/GPT-5.4 data. New AsyncIOScheduler is confirmed running via backend logs ('[Scheduler] Started auto-snapshot job (every 6h)' and '[Scheduler] Running snapshot for 1 tracked accounts' followed by '[Scheduler] Snapshot saved for @chilichidiu: 1472 followers'). GET /api/profile/chilichidiu/history returns 2 real snapshots inserted by the scheduler (timestamps 2026-07-24T10:52 and 10:59 UTC), proving the scheduled job is writing to Mongo. All prior endpoints (/api/, /api/accounts CRUD, /api/profile/{u}, /api/profile/{u}/activity, /api/relationships, /api/search, /api/image-proxy, /api/insights/{u}) still work. GPT-5.4 insights confirmed with all 4 required sections (Content Strategy, Audience, Engagement, Recommendation). Frontend UI polish verified: new FaUserSecret detective logo renders, 'Intelligence Bureau' tagline visible, numbered nav 01-06 present, corner-ornament 'Case File - Overview' header on Dashboard, case IDs (#0001) shown per tracked account, 'Active Investigations' section rendered, system-status footer showing Apify LIVE + GPT-5.4 READY with live pulse. Tracker/Activity/Reports/Ties&Trails/Search all render real Instagram data with all images loading via /api/image-proxy (naturalWidth>0). CSV Export button visible on Reports. Force graph renders on Ties & Trails. Search returns real @natgeo (268,965,439 followers, National Geographic).

minor.issue: Pre-existing: on LLM failure endpoint returns HTTP 200 with error message in 'insights' field instead of a non-2xx (carried over from iterations 1 & 2).
Pre-existing: 'category' returns literal string 'None' when Apify's businessCategoryName is the string 'None' rather than a missing key (carried over).

Older log lines show a prior NameError ('AsyncIOScheduler not defined') from an earlier reload cycle before the import was added. Current process (PID 5328) started successfully with the fix; no runtime impact. Just noise in backend.err.log history.

action_items: Optional (carried over): return non-2xx on /api/insights when LLM fails so UI can distinguish success from failure.
Optional (carried over): normalize 'None'/None/'' businessCategoryName values in fetch_instagram_profile.

Optional: image_proxy URL allowlist still uses substring match (in url); harden to hostname endswith('cdninstagram.com')/endswith('fbcdn.net')/endswith('.instagram.com') to prevent bypass via query params.
Optional: scheduler currently only runs the snapshot job every 6h; consider persisting job runs to Mongo (jobstore) so restarts don't cause double-runs when combined with next_run_time=now.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is one 439-line monolith. Recommend splitting into modules: apify_client.py, models.py, routes/*.py, scheduler.py. Will help maintainability as features grow.

Scheduler declares scheduler=AsyncIOScheduler(...) after @app.on_event('shutdown') references it; NameError risk if shutdown fires before the module-level line executes on some Python startups. Safer to declare scheduler before defining the shutdown handler (module-level top of file).
profile_cache is unbounded in-memory dict — memory will grow if many usernames get proxied. Consider using cachetools TTLCache with maxsize.
image_proxy has no per-IP rate limiting and no size cap; abuse risk on a public URL (unchanged from iteration_2).

Snapshot job uses fixed asyncio.sleep(5) between accounts — fine for 1 account but will not scale (e.g. 200 accounts = 1000s of blocking sleep inside the job). Consider concurrency-limited gather or randomized backoff.
get_ai_insights returns 200 with error text in insights on LLM failure, hiding failures from monitoring/alerting.
Dashboard.js triggers a /api/profile fetch per tracked account on mount; N+1 pattern. Consider a single /api/dashboard endpoint that returns aggregated cached data.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (6/6 pages render real Apify data + polished UI + images via proxy)

seed_data_creation: Test run added and removed @natgeo tracked account during pytest lifecycle. @chilichidiu remains as the pre-existing tracked account with 2 scheduler-driven snapshots in follower_snapshots.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Scheduler is verified working — every 6h it fetches fresh Apify data for all tracked accounts and inserts into follower_snapshots. To retest scheduler manually: (a) restart backend with `sudo supervisorctl restart backend`, (b) tail /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log for '[Scheduler] Started auto-snapshot job' and 'Snapshot saved for @X: N followers', (c) hit GET /api/profile/{u}/history and confirm new snapshot appended. UI polish (logo, numbered nav, case IDs, system status footer, Active Investigations) is fully in place. No regressions from iteration_2.
rca of the issue: N/A - no bugs found in this iteration. Scheduler works, all endpoints work, UI polish landed correctly.
